text: Residents have reached out to my office with concerns about road safety and speeding along Elmer Avenue, between Kingston Road and Norway Avenue. As the majority of residents are in favour of this safety initiative, I would like to recommend the installation of speed humps.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Elmer Avenue, between Kingston Road and Norway Avenue (west branch). 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install three speed humps on Elmer Avenue, between Kingston Road and Norway Avenue (west branch), generally as shown on Attachment 1 to the letter (November 7, 2023) from Councillor Brad Bradford.
